name: P-319 live self-serve hosted signup acceptance on app.papercusp.com (real WorkOS identity, headless browser)
summary: 5/5 live steps passed: ordinary sign-in refused with membership_required and zero admission writes; explicit sign-up admitted exactly one active owner membership in one new organization and landed on portal onboarding under the initial session; operator surface refused the hosted principal (403); sign-up replay reused the original admission with no new ledger row; ordinary sign-in then admitted the member.

environment.identityProvider: WorkOS AuthKit (mutual-marigold-79-staging), email and password method
environment.browser: verdict headless Chromium, fresh profile per run

assertions.evidence: ordinary sign-in landed on https://app.papercusp.com/?hosted_auth_error=membership_required&hosted_auth_recovery=1; census after: external_identities=0 hosted_users=0 memberships=0 signup_attempts=0 hosted_sessions_live=0

after Create account (intent=sign-up): memberships=1 (owner/active/organization_bootstrap org=b5fff314-f02e-4533-a1ec-f0c9dba65262 orgStatus=active), distinct_orgs=1, signup_attempts=completed, legal=terms@terms-2026-09,privacy@privacy-2026-09

landed on https://app.papercusp.com/ showing 'Set up your portal' onboarding (Organization, Workspace, Google connection, Home; links Create workspace and Continue to Home); /api/hosted/auth/session -> 200 org=b5fff314-f02e-4533-a1ec-f0c9dba65262 workspace=null subject=user_01M3Q03A6W4CPPBW3NWF73TXNE
ordinary sign-in after admission landed on https://app.papercusp.com/ with no hosted_auth_error

priorDefect.finding: a sign-up replay by an already-linked identity left a committed 'pending' hosted_signup_attempts row; recordAttempt wrote the ledger row before its linked-identity check
priorDefect.fix: self-signup.ts recordAttempt checks the linked identity before any ledger write (commit 65e00f7fb6); regression test self-signup.integration.test.ts 'does not rate-limit a returning user' fails before the fix (test run 20095658) and passes after (20095671)
priorDefect.verifiedLive: live2 step 4: signup_attempts stays at 1 after the replay
